lesson.child_mission: Comparing prices and best buys means checking same units (per item or per 100 g) before deciding which offer is better value.
lesson.evidence_instructions: Save the independent response, specific revisions and both short-answer explanations; record oral evidence for speaking tasks.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Which is better value: 2 notebooks for $5.00 or 3 for $6.60? Show unit prices.

FEEDBACK
$2.50 each vs $2.20 each — the 3-pack is better value per notebook.

WATCH FOR
Choosing the pack with the lower total price is not always the better unit price.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Compare ten best-buy pairs. Calculate unit prices and write a one-sentence decision for each.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
3 apples for $2.40 → 80 c each; 5 for $4.50 → 90 c each; the 3-pack is cheaper per apple. Always compare like with like.

TRY FIRST
Which is better value: 2 notebooks for $5.00 or 3 for $6.60? Show unit prices.

FEEDBACK
$2.50 each vs $2.20 each — the 3-pack is better value per notebook.
teach_steps.explain:
Comparing prices and best buys means checking same units (per item or per 100 g) before deciding which offer is better value.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
teach_steps.notice: Choosing the pack with the lower total price is not always the better unit price. Correct the value or method, not just the appearance of the digits.
